summary: Wacky Wheels San Antonio was down from 2027-03-19 to 2027-03-22, which led to 6 production orders being rescheduled at the same plant, 27 dealers notified once each for 55 customer orders, and 6 loaners assigned. In addition, Quanta Silicon infotainment chip shipment SH-0190 to Wacky Wheels Princeton slipped from 2027-03-15 to 2027-03-19, causing 8 affected production orders to be rescheduled to earliest free slots, 29 dealers notified once each for 67 customer orders, and 20 Platinum/Gold customers assigned loaners within pool limits. In total, 14 production orders were rescheduled, 41 dealers were notified, and 26 customer loaners were assigned.
decision_reason: The system acted because both confirmed incidents had identifiers and dates resolved against the data, handbook validators passed, and the pre-flight check on a sandbox copy of the enterprise passed. Furthermore, the live schedule baseline matched prior to writing, and the auditor verified that the outage and shipment delay were accurately interpreted and resolved according to policy rules.
